ITEM 2 | Two triangular/rectangular slices of flatbread-style pastry, golden-tan crust with dark brown charred spots, topped with melted pale cheese showing browning blisters and small darker bits, one slice about 9 cm long and 5 cm wide, the other about 8 cm long and 4 cm wide, lying flat on the lower-right of the plate | 120
